display_name: 原E200：物理扰动困难度与跨RX更新效用的配对诊断
description: 三种子固定E200，30批L的可恢复虚拟步；用其他RX/day的L选择动作，独立V仅前向观察，0持久训练
authorization: 持续84%目标及三个机制问题的源域研究；本批0持久身份/辅助更新，非目标性能驱动选型

code.commit: resolved from immutable Git release at launch

data.representation: equalized=1; center crop/pad 256; per-packet complex RMS; center=False; fs=25MHz

roles.U_use: IQ/RX/day/opaque UID;15domain round-robin, within-domain private permutation before reuse; no TX grouping or same-sig cross-RX pairing

data.split_id: inherited deterministic physical source roles (historical protocol label 392005)
data.train_ratio_definition: rho_label=L_s/(L_s+U_s)=0.1 unchanged; U_s TX truth never visible
data.diagnostic_access: Each batch30 L from oneRX/day; other4RX x other2days x6TX x2 gives96L and96V probes. L-only action selection; V no gradients/selection/fitted state. No U or target files.

permissions.claim_scope: finite virtual update utility on known source RX; not unknown-RX or target performance

checkpoint.initialization: fixed originalE200 and same-seed pretrained RANK_STATE; all virtual parameter changes restored exactly

parent_contract.sampling: shared seed-private source-L stream; 96 ordinary + 2x2x8 relation slots every8; no difficulty sampling
shared seed-private source-L stream; 96 ordinary + 2x2x8 relation slots every8; no difficulty sampling

averaging.buffers: fixed final buffers; BatchNorm architecture forbidden
averaging.selection: fixed five-snapshot mean; no V choice

action.fit: fresh original E200, same-scale tanh coordinates, abs noise, first full pass raw margin then full pass finite risk

evaluation.control_role: same40epoch budget and E200 parents; five fixed arms, no sourceV ranking

semi.teacher_init: after update888: cloned EMA or live stop-gradient student according to target_provider
semi.statistics_mask: separate physical quality, all soft assignments

parent_build_config.optimization_scope: all native identity encoder/fusion/classifier parameters; no frozen identity layers; domain networks frozen

physical.action_targets: four actual applied tap components / scale
physical.repetition_target: leave-cycle relative template residual24 + learned diagonal uncertainty
physical.known_linear_scope: small circular digital filter; interior-only diagnostic required

parent_build_config.mechanism_scope: Original identity gates/reference retained. Physical bank comes from L IQ only. Auxiliary critic explains bounded action difficulty and selects identity training inputs; it never duplicates TX classification. No EMA/satellite.

rx_action.L_fit: other five TX AND other two days
rx_action.U_fit: all six L TX, other two days; U TX never read
rx_action.critic_fit: actual deterministic CE increment on up to32L, identity detached; smoothL1; zero-action anchored
rx_action.action_selection: eight candidates: four other sourceRX times two fixed scales; no identity class prediction in bank lookup

state.normalization: L means/std only, floor1e-4; V transform frozen

half uniform plus half within-packet standardized-score softmax temperature1

notes: Difficulty prediction does not measure transfer utility; this diagnostic tests their relationship without loading target results.
Full L/V roles are6300/27000; only prespecified30 paired batches are evaluated, not fullV accuracy. Repeated probes are possible and are not independent observations.
L-selected uses a batch-level best action, not per-packet learned predictor; treat it as diagnostic upper bound conditioned on L, not deployable mechanism.
Both step sizes fixed before data observation; no V tuning. This is not AdamW replay or long-term training; no checkpoint is saved from virtual states.
